info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Model Associations API

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: page
params.description:
The 0-based number of the page of results to list.
Minimum: `0`
**Default:** `0`

params.name: pageSize
params.description:
The maximum number of results to include per page.
**Must be in range:** `[1, 1000]`
**Default:** `100`

items.docs:
Lists the organization associations corresponding to the specified pipelineId.

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"SEARCH_API","targetDomain":"QUERY_PIPELINE","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
